name: medikiosk
description: Root package.json for MediKiosk demo and Railway deployment

scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.demo: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.demo:stop: docker compose down 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM ollama.exe /T 2>nul & exit 0
